commit.subject: LU-20896 utils: no unaligned DIO for encrypted file copies
commit.message:
LU-20896 utils: no unaligned DIO for encrypted file copies

With the key loaded, "lfs migrate", "lfs mirror extend" and "lfs
mirror verify" of an encrypted file would fail with -EINVAL on a
client with pages larger than the 4KiB encryption unit, if the OSTs
did not support unaligned direct IO, e.g. 2.15 servers.  The
ciphertext of the file ends at the end of an encryption unit, so the
last direct write of migrate and extend was not a whole page, and
verify read up to the end of that unit.

Round the last direct write of an encrypted file in migrate and
extend up to a page, as llapi_mirror_copy() does, since the size of
the volatile file is set from the file afterward.  Round the reads
of verify up to a page, since the read stops at the end of the last
encryption unit.

Run migrate, extend and verify in sanity-sec test_66c with unaligned
DIO turned off, for any page size.
